unit.why: An old hasid's report that the rebbe excused his leadership by saying the Maggid and other tzaddikim had ordered him to lead, with the last of them urging him, through a midrash, to stop hiding; it closes with a related remark by the rebbe.

stories.start_quote: סיפר לי חסיד מפורסם איש זקן
stories.end_quote: אני מוסמך הרבה והרבה יותר ממנו
stories.summary_en: The rebbe apologized for his leadership, saying his great-grandfather the Maggid and other tzaddikim had ordered him to be a rebbe; the last of them, R. Y. of Pressburg/Przedbórz, applied the midrash 'uncover your breasts, it is not a time for modesty' to him; the rebbe once also said he was far more ordained than a famous tzaddik of the day.

tags.why: Tzaddikim command him to accept leadership.
The tale centres on how he came to accept the role of rebbe.
He is reluctant about his own leadership and must be told to stop concealing himself.
